changes.summary: Return a concrete typed Elysia 2 RC plugin instead of ElysiaLike. Remove the fake app injection hook and test real HTTP composition; retain standard health responses and lazy Elysia loading.

migration.instruction: Upgrade Elysia to 2.0.0-rc.0 or later and mount await healthPlugin({ checker }) directly with app.use. Remove makeElysia; tests should use Elysia.handle with a controlled checker.
